메모: 10번 B2B 기업 홍보영상 「도담중공업」 — 시댄스 2.5 1일 무제한 웹 판 지시문(2026-10-31, 지시문_시댄스웹.py가 만듦). 10-29 결정 「포트폴리오도 손님 납품도 Seedance 2.5 720p」로 9절 견적의 Omni 길 대신 이 판으로 낸다. 시작 그림은 10-27 이미지 콘티 보드와 같은 고르기(고름/ 30 · 33, 나머지는 받음/ · 받음_gpt/판/의 가장 최근 판)를 git 밖 콘티/p10/시댄스/에 모은 것(--그림), 모두 16:9 — 후반에서 원본처럼 약 2:1 띠로 자른다. 카메라는 02_콘티 2절 카메라 칸 · 10절(원본 실측) 그대로이고 장비 이름 · 오빗 말 · 1.5° 아래 롤은 쓰지 않았다. 10절이 「영상 단계에서 굽는다」고 한 끝 그림(7 · 12 · 19 · 20 · 35 · 37)은 아직 없어 끝 모습을 글로 쓰고, 19만 기준 그림 R5(트레일러 · 터빈)를 참고로 넣는다(참고 없는 19b는 대안). 얼굴은 준호뿐이고 입은 늘 다문다. 소리 끔 — 내레이션 · 노래 · 화면 글 · 회사 이름은 후반. 길이 = max(4, ⌈쓰는 초 + 0.8⌉), 두 샷 = ⌈자르는 초 + 둘째 쓰는 초 + 0.8⌉. 꾸러미는 ../../../시댄스무제한/웹꾸러미.py. 10-31 Fable 결제 전 검수(P1 2 · P2 8 · P3 6, git 밖 콘티/검수/시댄스앞_여섯편_20261031/p10/review.md) 반영 — 12 둘째 작업자는 화면 오른쪽 밖에서 들어오고 공통 LOOK은 「not in the first frame or written in ACTION」, 37은 S37이 이미 불이 켜진 그림이라 「불빛이 번져 더 밝아짐」, 28 날개는 천천히 선명하게, 8+9는 샷마다 제 빛, 29 · 30 낱판은 묶음과 함께 주판.

공통.장르: a cinematic, documentary-style brand film for a Korean heavy-industry company that builds gas turbines for power plants

누구.JUNHO: the same Korean man in his early forties in every shot — short, neat black hair, no glasses, exactly the face of the first frame; a navy zip-up work jacket over a plain grey T-shirt. He never speaks: his lips stay closed, and his face stays calm, quiet and serious — no big expressions.
누구.JUNHO_BACK: Junho seen from behind — short, neat black hair and his navy work jacket; his face is not seen and he does not turn around.
누구.JUNHO_HAND: Junho's own hand and forearm, in the sleeve of his navy work jacket.
누구.CREW: every other worker is seen only as hands, a back, a far-away figure or behind a welding helmet or mask, exactly as in the first frame — no other face is ever shown, and nobody turns toward the camera.
누구.TURBINE: the same big power-plant gas turbine in every shot — a long cream-white casing with rows of bolts and a round black bladed intake with a black cone at its front end; no logo, letters or numbers anywhere on it.
누구.DRIVER: the truck driver — only his hands, his arm in a light-grey work jacket and his shoulder are ever in the frame; his head always stays above the top edge of the frame.

공통.보기: LOOK: a cinematic documentary brand film — real cinema camera, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, natural motion blur, true-to-life textures of steel, sparks and skin. Each shot keeps its first frame's light — direction, color, white balance and darkness — to the very end; only the light changes written in ACTION may happen. No new text, letters, numbers, logos or signs anywhere; never add anyone who is neither in the first frame nor written in ACTION; every machine keeps exactly the shape, size and parts it has in the first frame.
공통.소리: SOUND: silent clip — no dialogue, no narration, no music.

판.설명: 준호 눈 극접사 — 아래 도면의 푸른 불빛이 눈동자에, 1.1초까지 거의 고정 → 끝 0.5초 위로 10% 기울임

샷.동작: Extreme close-up of Junho's face from his eyes down to his cheek, lit from below by the cold blue glow of a turbine blueprint on the desk below the frame; the blue lines reflect in his eyes. He studies it in silence — his eyes move slowly along the drawing; his lips stay closed.
샷.카메라: handheld and almost still for the first 1.1 s — only a slow float that slides the picture about 4% of the frame width to the right; then from 1.1 s to 1.6 s the camera tilts up by about 10% of the frame height (the picture moves down, so his eyes sink toward the lower part of the frame), with no zoom; from 1.6 s it holds still.

판.설명: 어두운 책상 위 푸른 터빈 단면 도면(글자 없음) — 오른쪽 아래로 미끄러지며 3° 돎

샷.동작: Close-up of a blue turbine cross-section drawing lying on a dark desk — thin pale lines, circles and the outline of turbine blades on deep navy paper, the edge of a steel ruler along the lower right. Nothing on the desk moves. There are no letters or numbers on the drawing.
샷.카메라: a slow, smooth slide from the first frame to the last at an even speed — the camera glides to the right and a little down, so the drawing slides about 3.5% of the frame width to the left and about 2.5% up, while the picture slowly turns by about 3°; no shake, no zoom.

판.설명: 어두운 공장 바닥에 튀는 불꽃 — 거의 고정 · 작은 손떨림

샷.동작: Low on the dark, damp concrete floor of the factory: showers of bright orange sparks from a grinder just out of the frame rain down and skip across the floor toward the camera, bouncing, scattering and fading, nonstop for the whole clip.
샷.카메라: the frame stays where it is, low on the floor, with only a very small natural handheld tremble in place; no push-in, no zoom, no pan.

판.설명: 어둠 → 0.15초 용접 불꽃이 켜지며 두꺼운 강판이 호박빛으로 — 고정

샷.동작: Near darkness: the tip of a welding rod hangs just above the edge of a thick steel plate, with only a faint blue spark. At about 0.15 s the welding arc flares into a blinding white-gold light that floods the steel plate with amber; sparks spray out to both sides and thin white smoke rises from the weld; it keeps burning bright to the end.
샷.카메라: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the steel plate and the welding rod never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no drift, no shake; only the light, the sparks and the smoke move.

판.설명: 어둠 속 용접 — 헬멧으로 얼굴을 가린 용접공 · 푸른 불꽃 · 흰 연기, 고르게 다가감 5%

샷.동작: In the dark workshop, a welder in a dark welding helmet — his face completely hidden — bends over the joint and welds: a hissing blue-white arc at his gloved hand throws sparks, and white smoke curls up past the helmet, for the whole clip.
샷.카메라: a slow, steady push-in from the very first frame — the camera physically moves forward, so the welder grows by about 5% in the first 1.1 s, at the same constant speed for the whole clip; no shake, no pan, no tilt.

판.설명: 밝은 불꽃 → 배관 틈 너머 보안경 · 마스크로 얼굴을 가린 용접공(붉은 작업복) — 고정

샷.동작: Through a gap between blurred steel pipes in the foreground: a welder in a rust-red work jacket, his face covered by a welding mask and goggles, welds on a big turbine part. The torch flares bright for the first 0.3 s, then settles to a steady glow, and orange sparks keep spraying from it.
샷.카메라: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the pipes and the machine never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no drift, no shake; only the welder, the sparks and the light move.

판.설명: 터빈 속 배관 사이 렌치를 작게 두 번 돌리는 장갑 손 → 카메라가 오른쪽 위로 부드럽게 따라가 작업모 쓴 조립공의 어깨 · 뒤통수(얼굴 없음)

샷.동작: Inside the turbine's tangle of steel pipes, a gloved hand works a wrench on a pipe fitting — two slow, small quarter-turns — and stays on the fitting. The camera leaves the hand and finds the assembler's dark shoulder and the back of his head under a dark work cap; his face stays turned away into the machine and is never seen. No one appears except the assembler whose hand and shoulder are in the first frame.
샷.카메라: a smooth, steady follow — from the very first frame the camera moves up and to the right at a steady speed, so the picture slides about half the frame width to the left and about half the frame height down by 2.1 s, then it eases out over the last half second; it also moves in slightly (about 5%); no shake, no zoom.

판.설명: 정면 큰 압축기 날개 원(화면 가득), 원 너머 멀리 서 있는 사람 — 고르게 다가감 9% → 날개 원 가운데 원판 · 날개 뿌리 접사(위에 노란 띠) — 다가감 10%(앞 0.8초 빠르게, 끝에 거의 멈춤)(두 샷 묶음) — 두 샷의 빛이 달라 각 샷이 제 그림 빛을 지키게(머리 구절을 판 칸 「같은때말」로)
판.같은때말: the same moment, the same place and the same machine; each shot keeps the light and colors of its own reference image — SHOT 1 the bright daylight of @이미지 1, SHOT 2 the darker bronze light of @이미지 2;

샷.동작: Head-on in front of a huge compressor blade ring that fills the frame — rows of dark steel blades around a big round opening; through the opening, far away in the bright hall, one worker stands small by the tall windows, green trees outside. Nothing moves; the far worker stays still.
샷.카메라: a slow, steady push-in from the very first frame — the camera physically moves forward toward the opening, so the ring grows by about 9% over 1.9 s, at exactly the same speed the whole time; no shake, no pan, no tilt.

샷.동작: A close-up of the center of the blade ring: the round machined steel hub and the roots of the dark blades fanning out around it, a thin strip of yellow safety tape along the top edge. Nothing moves.
샷.카메라: a push-in from the first frame of this shot — fast until 3.4 s, then easing to almost a stop by 3.7 s; the hub grows by about 10%; no shake, no pan, no tilt.

판.설명: 흰 조명 조립동 와이드 — 받침대 위 터빈 로터, 옆에 작업자 둘(작게, 얼굴 없음) — 물러남 13%(처음 빠르고 갈수록 느려져 멈춤) → 터빈 몸통 밑 낮은 자리 — 위로 케이스, 아래로 흰 안전모 쓴 작업자 정수리(얼굴 없음) — 거의 고정(두 샷 묶음)

샷.동작: A wide view of the bright, white-lit assembly hall: a long turbine rotor with rows of blades lies on steel stands, a big casing section beside it, a yellow overhead crane above. Two small workers in grey work clothes and white hard hats stand by the rotor with their faces turned toward it; they barely move.
샷.카메라: a pull-back from the very first frame — the camera physically moves backward, so the whole hall shrinks by about 13% by 2.2 s: fastest at the start, slowing steadily, and stopped at 2.2 s; no shake, no pan, no tilt.

샷.동작: Low under the curved belly of the turbine casing, which fills the top of the frame: at the bottom, a worker in a white hard hat bends over his work, seen from above and behind — only the top of his hat and his shoulder show; his face is never seen. The bright hall glows behind.
샷.카메라: almost still — the frame stays where it is with only a tiny handheld float in place; no push-in, no zoom, no pan.

판.설명: 어두운 작업장 작업대 앞 작업자 뒷모습 → 아래로 따라 기울이면 화면 오른쪽 밖에서 들어와 날개 하나를 들고 지나가는 둘째 작업자(가슴 아래) — 손떨림 · 살짝 다가감

샷.동작: In a dim workshop full of workbenches under warm work lamps, a worker stands at his bench, seen from behind; his face is never seen. Then a second worker, who has been waiting just outside the right edge of the frame, walks past close in front of the camera, seen only from the chest down, carrying a single long, curved turbine blade in both gloved hands; from about 1.2 s the blade sweeps into the lower half of the frame and fills the middle of the frame from top to bottom by the end, his gloved hands on its right edge. No one appears except the two workers written in ACTION.
샷.카메라: handheld with a natural shake; from the very first frame the camera tilts down, slowly at first and faster and faster (fastest around 1.5–1.75 s), so the picture moves up by about 40% of the frame height by 2 s, while the camera also moves in a little (about 12%).

판.설명: 두 팔로 검은 케이스 덮개를 받치는 작업자(뒷모습), 오른쪽 뒤 다른 작업자 — 손에 든 흔들림 → 어깨 너머 — 장갑 낀 손이 덮개 이음매를 한 번 천천히 눌러 맞춤(얼굴 없음) — 살짝 물러남 9% · 위로 조금(두 샷 묶음)

샷.동작: In the bright assembly hall, a worker in a grey work jacket and a white hard hat, seen from behind, holds a heavy dark casing cover up against the turbine with both arms raised, steadying it; another worker stands small in the background on the right. Their faces are never seen.
샷.카메라: handheld with a small natural shake, drifting slightly sideways; no zoom.

샷.동작: Over the shoulder of a worker in a dark cap and a dark work jacket (his face never seen): his gloved hand presses once, slowly and firmly, along the seam of the big dark casing cover to seat it, fingers kept together, from 2 s to 3 s; the bright hall stretches behind.
샷.카메라: from the first frame of this shot the camera pulls back slowly and rises a little — the picture shrinks by about 9% by 3.5 s, at an even pace; smooth, no shake.

판.설명: 어두운 날개 사이에 든 팔 · 장갑이 더 깊이 들어감 — 손에 든 흔들림

샷.동작: In the dark between big curved black turbine blades, a worker's arm in a dark sleeve and a black glove, already between the blades from the first frame, slides in deeper, as if fitting one into place.
샷.카메라: handheld with a natural shake, nudged along as the arm slides in deeper; no zoom, no pan.

판.설명: 검은 날개 원 앞면 · 가운데 원뿔, 오른쪽에 준호 옆얼굴(제자리에서 눈으로 날개를 따라감 — 첫 등장) — 카메라가 둘레로 오른쪽으로 미끄러짐 12%

샷.동작: In the bright assembly hall, the turbine's front fills the left: the round black bladed intake with its black cone, inside the cream-white casing. On the right, close to the lens, Junho in profile looks into the blades, quiet and serious, lips closed; he keeps the same pose and does not turn — only his eyes follow the blades slowly; otherwise only the camera moves.
샷.카메라: the camera glides smoothly to the right around him at a steady pace from the very first frame — the blade ring and its cone slide to the left by about 12% of the frame width in 1.1 s, while Junho stays at about the same place on the right of the frame; no shake, no zoom.

판.설명: 흰 조립동 — 덮개 열린 터빈 정면 와이드, 아래 작은 사람 셋 — 고정

샷.동작: A wide, head-on view in the white-lit assembly hall: the turbine stands on its stand with the casing panels around its front opened up, showing the round black bladed intake and its cone; three small workers stand around its base, seen from behind or far away. They shift only slightly.
샷.카메라: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the turbine and the hall never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no drift, no shake; only the small workers move.

판.설명: 준호가 위를 올려다봄(옆얼굴, 노란 크레인) — 인물 둘레로 살짝 돌아감(바탕 20% · 5° 기욺)

샷.동작: Junho, in the bright hall under the yellow overhead crane, looks up at the turbine towering above him, still and quiet, lips closed. He keeps the same pose and the same head angle the whole time — he does not turn; only his eyes travel slowly upward along the machine, and he breathes.
샷.카메라: the camera swings gently sideways to the left around him while staying on his face: the hall behind him — the steel columns and the yellow crane — slides to the right by about 20% of the frame width in 1 s, while Junho stays at about the same place in the frame; the horizon tilts gently by about 5° as it moves. Only the camera moves; light handheld feel.

판.설명: 트레일러 흙받이의 노란 아기 그림 표지(글자 없음) 접사 → 크레인처럼 올라가며 물러나 흰 터빈이 실린 트레일러 전체 — 참고 그림 R5(옴니 레퍼런스로 올림 · 2_참고를 끝 프레임 칸에 넣지 않음)
판.참고말: @이미지 2 is a reference only for what the rising camera reveals — the same long multi-axle low-bed trailer and the same cream-white turbine on it, its black bladed intake facing the rear. It is not the last frame and not a separate shot; the mud flap and its yellow baby sign stay exactly as in @이미지 1.

샷.동작: Close-up of the rear mud flap of a heavy low-bed trailer standing still on a concrete yard: a scuffed, dusty light-grey flap with a small yellow diamond sign that shows only a baby's face, no letters; the big tires on the right and red tail lights on the left. As the camera rises and pulls back, the whole trailer is revealed — a long multi-axle low-bed trailer carrying the huge cream-white gas turbine, its black bladed intake facing the rear, strapped down and ready to leave. Nothing on it moves.
샷.카메라: a smooth crane move that rises and pulls back: it starts slowly in the first 0.5 s, speeds up, is fastest between 1.5 s and 2.5 s, keeps moving a little slower until 4.0 s, then eases quickly to a stop by 4.5 s. The mud flap with its yellow sign shrinks to the bottom of the frame and slips out below it by about 3.7 s; at the end the picture has pulled back to about a quarter of its starting scale: the turbine on the trailer fills the frame, its black bladed intake facing the camera. Perfectly smooth, no shake.

판.설명: 트럭 운전석 — 기어 잡은 손 → 운전대 손 → 어깨 · 옆 창(창밖은 콘크리트 마당, 머리는 화면 밖, 얼굴 없음) — 손에 든 채 빠르게 돌아 나감

샷.동작: Inside the truck cab: the driver's right hand, in the sleeve of a light-grey work jacket, holds the gear lever and shifts it once at the start; his other hand rests on the steering wheel. Only his hands, arm and shoulder are ever seen — his head always stays above the top edge of the frame, and nobody turns toward the camera. Outside the window, the bright concrete yard exactly as in the first frame. No one appears except the driver whose arm is in the first frame.
샷.카메라: handheld, a quick swing from the very first frame: the camera rises and pulls back toward the upper left — off the gear hand, past his hand on the steering wheel at about 0.7 s, to his shoulder and the side window by about 1.5 s; fastest between 0.5 s and 1.3 s, then it slows and is almost still from 2.0 s; the picture shrinks by about a quarter as it pulls back; natural handheld shake.

판.설명: 운전석 창밖 둥근 사이드미러, 거울 속에 실려 가는 터빈 — 고정

샷.동작: From the driver's seat, looking out of the open side window: the round convex side mirror on its steel arm; in the mirror, the long trailer with the cream-white turbine follows behind, steady. The concrete yard beyond.
샷.카메라: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the window frame and the mirror arm never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no drift, no shake.

판.설명: 한낮 바깥 — 시험대 틀에 걸린 터빈, 뒤로 언덕 숲 — 아주 살짝 다가감 2% → 한낮 — 큰 콘크리트 시험동 입구 와이드, 철골에 걸린 터빈 · 작은 사람 — 아주 살짝 다가감 2%(두 샷 묶음)

샷.동작: Outdoors in bright midday light: the turbine hangs in a big steel test-stand frame under a steel roof, its black bladed intake toward the left; green wooded hills and blue sky behind. Nothing moves.
샷.카메라: a very slow, even push-in from the very first frame — the camera physically moves forward, the picture grows by about 2% in 1.1 s; no shake.

샷.동작: Midday: a wide view of the huge concrete test building's open entrance; the turbine sits in its steel frame in the doorway, a small worker standing near it, a strip of green grass in the foreground. Nothing moves.
샷.카메라: a very slow, even push-in from the first frame of this shot — the camera physically moves forward, the picture grows by about 2% by 3.4 s; no shake.

판.설명: 어두운 시험동 — 흡음판 벽 통로 끝의 터빈 정면, 아래 흰 안전모 작업자 뒷모습 — 고정

샷.동작: In the dark test cell lined with rows of square sound-absorbing panels, the turbine faces the camera head-on at the end of the long room, its blades still; at the bottom center a worker in a white hard hat stands with his back to the camera, still.
샷.카메라: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the room and the turbine never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no drift, no shake; only the worker moves, and only very slightly.

판.설명: 준호 3/4 얼굴 접사(그림처럼 왼쪽을 봄), 어둠 속 호박빛(관제실 조명 — 불꽃 아님) — 긴장 · 0.5초 숨 한 번, 거의 고정
